newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ATHLETICS-PEREC PULLS OUT OF WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PEREC PULLS OUT OF WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: France's double Olympic champion Marie-Jose Perec has pulled out of next month's world athletics championships because of her disappointing form this season.
After finishing second in a 200 metres race at the Lausanne grand prix on Wednesday, Perec said her form was not good enough to defend her women's 400 metres title at the Athens championships.
"I have won Olympic and world titles and I am not going to go to an event where I can't win," said Perec, the Olympic 200 and 400 metres champion.
"I'm going to continue training and look towards the second half of the season. But at the moment things don't feel right."

Perec's decision has not come as a surprise since the French runner has been struggling to reach her best for several weeks. On Wednesday she clocked 22.76 seconds to finish just behind Australian winner Melinda Gainsford.
